game.name: Ufc 2009 Undisputed (Japan)
game.desc: UFC 2009 Undisputed on Xbox 360 is a fighting game based on the Ultimate Fighting Championship rules and environments. In these competitions, all styles are allowed and only a few punches are forbidden. The title features a hundred or so fighters from the 5 weight categories and representing all the disciplines (martial or not) present in the ring: judo, Brazilian ju-jitsu or Muay Thai. The game features the names of the greatest fighters in the competition
